توضح هذه السياسة كيف تلغي اشتراكك في DEV: This policy explains how to cancel your DEV MENU subscription and when you can get a refund. It is part of the terms and conditions.
التجربة المجانية لمدة 7 أيام لا تتطلب أي: The 7-day free trial needs no payment, so there is nothing to refund, and you can stop using it at any time.
يمكنك الإلغاء في أي وقت عبر \"راسل الإدا: You can cancel at any time through "Contact admin" in the dashboard or by contacting us.
لا يتجدد الاشتراك بخصم تلقائي، فإذا لم ت: Subscriptions do not renew by automatic charge, so if you do not renew you will not be asked to pay anything more.
تستمر خدماتك حتى نهاية المدة المدفوعة ثم: Your services keep running until the end of the paid period and then stop for customers.
أول اشتراك مدفوع: يحق لك استرداد المبلغ: First paid subscription: you can get a full refund if you ask within 7 days of paying.
التجديد والفروع والخدمات المضافة أثناء ا: Renewals, branches and services added during a subscription are not refundable once activated, unless you ask within 48 hours of paying and they have not been used.
إذا انقطعت الخدمة بسبب من جهتنا لأكثر من: If the service is down for more than 72 hours in a row because of a problem on our side, we extend your subscription by the number of days lost, or refund their value if you prefer.
لا يُسترد أي مبلغ عن حساب أُوقف بسبب مخا: No refund is given for an account suspended for a serious breach of the terms or the acceptable use policy.
تواصل معنا بالبريد أو الواتساب واذكر اسم: Contact us by email or WhatsApp with your business name and invoice number. We reply within 3 working days, and the money is returned to the same payment method within 14 days of approval.
نحتفظ ببيانات منشأتك 90 يوماً بعد انتهاء: We keep your business data for 90 days after your subscription ends so you can come back without setting everything up again, and after that we may delete it. You can ask us to delete it straight away at any time.
